source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 34 (provisos: Mah. 20 of 2002 s.8(d); Mah. 20 of 2015 s.20(18); Mah. 59 of 2017)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 34 (both columns, IGR text): 'GIFT, Instrument of — not being a Settlement (Article 55) or Will or Transfer (Article 59) — The same duty as is leviable on a Conveyance under clause (a), (b) or (c), as the case may be, of Article 25, on the market value of the property which is the subject matter of the gift. Provided that, if the property is gifted to a family member being the husband, wife, brother or sister of the donor or any lineal ascendant or descendant of the donor, then the amount of duty chargeable shall be at the rate of 3 percent [subst. by Mah. 59 of 2017 w.e.f. 7-9-2017] on the market value ... Provided further that, if the residential and agricultural property is gifted to husband, wife, son, daughter, grandson, grand-daughter, wife of deceased son, the amount of duty chargeable shall be rupees two hundred [subst. for Two Hundred by Mah. 20 of 2015].'

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official IGR text; both provisos quoted). This is the PRD §5.5 per-state relative-list showcase — encoded as an explicit enumerated list, NEVER generalized. gift_relation (set by the questionnaire from relation + property type): 'close_family_residential_agri' → Rs 200 (Proviso 2: residential/agricultural to husband/wife/son/daughter/grandson/granddaughter/wife-of-deceased-son); 'family' → 3% (Proviso 1: husband/wife/brother/sister/lineal ascendant/descendant, ANY property); default → full area-based Conveyance rate (cross-ref Art 25, no transfer/cess imported). PRECEDENCE: Proviso 2 (Rs 200) is more specific and more beneficial than Proviso 1 (3%) for the overlapping spouse/child + residential/agri case — the questionnaire must pick 'close_family_residential_agri' there. Metro cess/LBT (PENDING) would ride on the default and 3% cases via Art 25's future surcharge modifiers; the Rs 200 fixed case is not ad valorem.

source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 34 provisos as they stood before Mah. Act 59 of 2017
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 34 Proviso 1 PRIOR to Mah. 59 of 2017 (IGR footnote 3): the family-member rate read 'at the same rate as specified in this article OR at the rate of rupees ten for every rupees five hundred or part thereof on the market value ... WHICHEVER IS LESS' — i.e. min(Conveyance rate, 2%). Mah. 59 of 2017 substituted 'at the rate of 3 percent' and deleted 'whichever is less' (footnote 4), both w.e.f. 7-9-2017. Proviso 2 (residential/agricultural to close family — Rs 200) was added by Mah. 20 of 2015 s.20(18) w.e.f. 24-1-2015.

notes_for_reviewer: BACK-CATALOGUE (2015-01-01 → 2017-09-06). Family gift = min(Conveyance rate, 2%) per the pre-2017 'whichever is less' text. Every pre-2017 conveyance rate (gram 3%, council 4%, corp 5%, movable 3%) EXCEEDS 2%, so the min is always 2% — encoded as a flat 2% rather than a min() over charges, which the model cannot express. If the founder finds any pre-2017 area rate below 2%, this simplification breaks and must become an explicit min. EDGE: Proviso 2 (Rs 200) only existed from 24-1-2015, so 1–23 Jan 2015 is technically outside it; not versioned separately (23-day window, commercially immaterial) — flagged rather than silently ignored.
